items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Herman Lubinsky, he was, he was the owner of the label.

ctx.x: Herman Lubinsky, he was, he was the owner of the label. I just forget all the names, the tunes that we did, but I liked the label very much. It was one of those good old stomp down, drag out labels, you know, where you'd get up there and swing and stomp and go on, and I did quite a few recording dates for Savoy.

There's a re-issue of a lot of those records have been reissued recently. Let's see, they put out an anthology of various tenor players, Ben Webster and his version of 'Body and Soul' that Ben had done and that you had recorded with.
